title: DifficultBulletinBoard
wikitext: '''Difficult Bulletin Board''' scans world chat and organizes messages into an easy-to-read interface, making it simple to find groups, services, or updates. == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager''' The easiest way to keep '''DifficultBulletinBoard''' up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/DeterminedPanda/DifficultBulletinBoard.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and rename the folder to DifficultBulletinBoard, removing the -master suffix. # Move the folder into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. == Git Links == * [https://github.com/DeterminedPanda/DifficultBulletinBoard '''(DeterminedPanda)'''] == Usage == '''Opening the Bulletin Board''' * Type /dbb or left-click the minimap icon to open the interface. * The main window displays organized chat messages. '''Managing Topics''' * Right-click the minimap icon to open options. * Use checkboxes to follow/unfollow specific topics. * Use /dbb to toggle the main interface. '''Tabs''' * '''Groups''': Find or post group messages. * '''Groups Logs''': View recent group chat entries. * '''Professions''': Search for crafting services. * '''Hardcore Messages''': Track hardcore-related events (deaths, level-ups). '''Filtering (in Groups Logs)''' * Use the filter box next to "Group Logs" to filter entries. * Enter comma-separated keywords to filter messages containing those terms. '''Chat Interactions''' * Click on a name: ** Left-click: Whisper (/w) or shift-left-click: /who. ** Right-click: Invite (/invite). '''Minimap Button''' * Shift+Click to move the minimap button. == Preview == [[File:Dbb.png|frameless|496x496px]] == Customization & Settings == '''Access Settings''' * Right-click minimap icon → Options. * Adjust: ** Font size ** Number of entries per topic ** Time display format (fixed or elapsed) ** Server time position ** Filtering options ** Sounds on open/close '''Using the Options Menu''' * Resize, enable/disable features. * Set topics to monitor. * Save settings to reload UI. == Troubleshooting == * '''No messages appear?''' Ensure you're in world chat (/join world). * '''Tags list issues?''' Press "Reset" in options to refresh. * '''Filtering not working?''' Check the keyword blacklist and filter box. * '''UI glitches?''' Reload UI with /reload. == Contact & Support == * Create an issue on GitHub for help or feature requests. [[Category:Addon]]
